integrity: The mathematical proof and a standalone Python 3 checker enumerate all divisor pairs surviving rigorously established finite cutoffs. No external validation or formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the prime-support/total-prime-factor stratum omega(n)=3 and Omega(n)=4; no claims about Omega(n)>=5 or more prime supports. Finite calculations are justified as exhaustive only after the stated algebraic cutoffs. An unindexed equivalent literature result remains possible.
title: The four-factor layer of three-prime \(2\)-near-perfect integers
